notes: Full evidence dump for findings/T773-liveness-fuse.json: the kill census, the red-before quotes, and the green-after quotes. Census method: enumerate untracked/runs/*.json with killed/signal/killed_by; classify agent lanes by child binary; for each stdout-class kill, match a pi session file in ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--Users-alex-Project-Zig-weizigo--/ whose launch timestamp is within ±30 s of the record's start (for the pre-T650 overwritten records T526/T635, matched by the bundle prompt fragment in the session head; their kill walls come from _LOG_ONLY_KILLED_ATTEMPTS in tools/runner and '[runner] KILL: progress timeout 600s' in untracked/log/t526.log / t635.log); parse each session for records, assistant turns, usage presence, first/last record timestamps, and the last-record offset as a fraction of the kill wall. DENOMINATOR: 8 recorded stdout-class kills of agent lanes (startup liveness / progress timeout / silent-child wall fallback) with a run record or documented wall; 8 of 8 have a session file (or, for claude T616, a 43 KB deliverable on disk) proving the lane was working. T616's session evidence is the Race F deliverable documented in docs/infra/model-task-matrix.md §2b ('terminated at 600.8 s by the stdout-only liveness fuse with its 43 KB deliverable already written, recorded verified=fail fail=row'). The 8 sessions' measured activity: T526 recs=102 turns=42 usage=True last=+529.0s of 1129.6s wall (47%); T573 recs=267 turns=119 usage=True last=+1340.0s of 2701.0s (50%); T628 recs=155 turns=66 usage=True last=+862.0s of 1463.2s (59%); T635 recs=227 turns=104 usage=True last=+1132.0s of 1732.6s (65%); T638 recs=172 turns=71 usage=True last=+1301.0s of 1901.3s (68%); T643 recs=160 turns=73 usage=True last=+1106.0s of 1706.8s (65%); T735 recs=86 turns=40 usage=True last=+600.0s of 600.9s (100%). ZERO recorded kills in the class are provably idle. OUT-OF-CLASS recorded kills (host-pressure / RSS, notes already measure avail/floor/RSS): T527, T531, T630, T636, T661, T696, T697, T699, T721, T724; T636's session shows work to 100% of wall; T630/T661/T699/T721 carry session_path in their records. Non-model fixture records (T362, T491, T515, T548MAN2-4, TL1A-F: python sleeps / zig build test / RSS-cap regression stubs) are not agent lanes and are excluded. RED BEFORE (test written first, run against HEAD aec5733): survives-session arm — 'FAIL: survives-session — expected exit 0 with the session file written, got 124' with '[runner] KILL: startup liveness timeout 2s (2s) — agent lane produced no output since launch (bundle never read?)' and exit 124 while sess.jsonl was being written (the T735 shape); survives-fallback arm — exit 124 while $WORK/sessions/session.jsonl was being written every second; hung arm — 'FAIL: hung — the kill note still asserts the causal claim bundle never read?'. GREEN AFTER (fixed runner): 'PASS: survives-session — buffered pi lane (no stdout, --session growing past startup-timeout) not killed; exit 0'; 'PASS: survives-fallback — buffered pi lane (no stdout, session-dir growing) not killed; exit 0'; 'PASS: hung — truly silent pi lane killed at startup-timeout (exit 124), note states measurements only'; 'PASS: scoping — non-agent silent for 2s > startup-timeout 1s was not killed'. The hung-arm note in full: 'startup liveness timeout 3s (3s) — no stdout bytes since launch; no pi session activity since launch (sensor: pi session dir '/Users/alex/.pi/agent/sessions/--tmp-weizigo-t773-pisess-XXXXXX--')'. NO-CAUSE GREP: grep -n 'bundle never read' tools/runner -> only two comment lines (1617, 3330) documenting the historical defect, never an emitted string; every kill_reason assignment is measurement-only (list in findings/T773-liveness-fuse.json). FUSE SEMANTICS: last_pi_session_activity initialises to t0 (launch) and advances on any strictly-newer session mtime (scan throttled ~1 s); the fuse fires when now - last_pi_session_activity >= startup_timeout, so a dead lane still dies at --startup-timeout exactly as before and a lane whose session stalls dies startup_timeout after its last write. Session files created BEFORE spawn_epoch are excluded (the launch-epoch rule the claude sensor uses) so a stale file in the shared cwd-slug dir can never mark a hung lane alive. WEIZIGO_PI_SESSIONS_DIR overrides the session dir for the regression; the --session file form is resolved against os.getcwd() (pi's own resolution rule, the same as _capture_tokens). ONE SCAN SERVES BOTH: _pi_session_scan_target resolves the file-or-dir target once; the liveness fuse consumes it here, and the token meter (T751, separately dispatched) consumes the same fallback via token-capture.py's default_sessions_dir — stated, not implemented here (T751's scope). REGRESSIONS GREEN (run 2026-08-23): startup-liveness 3/3, claude-liveness 3/3, agent-progress 5/5, pi-session-liveness 4/4, reporting, run-records, brief-telemetry, harness-p95, taskid, guard, reap, host-guard — all exit 0.
